previous_statement: Since 0<=L^0*epsilon<=W.L*epsilon=epsilon_R, the defining inequalities in def-epsilon-cstar-algebra only weaken when the defect parameter is enlarged, at every matrix level in def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra. Hence A_R is an extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra. Also every direct-envelope error is <=L^0*epsilon<=W.L*epsilon=epsilon_R<=t_3, so the target ambient record and every other envelope-produced datum error are dominated by t_3.
new_statement: Since 0<=L^0*epsilon<=W.L*epsilon=epsilon_R, the defining inequalities in def-epsilon-cstar-algebra only weaken when the defect parameter is enlarged, at every matrix level in def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra; hence A_R is an extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra. The direct-envelope errors used here split into projection defects bounded by c0*epsilon and subordination/complementarity errors bounded by L^0*epsilon. The former are at most c0*W.L*epsilon<=W.K3*epsilon=t_3, while the latter are at most W.L*epsilon=epsilon_R<=t_3; also epsilon_R<=t_3. Thus the target ambient record and every direct-envelope projection/subordination/complementarity error used in the Stage-3 datum are dominated by t_3.
